text:
ada: quick design check — bulk delete modal vs inline confirm. which pattern should we standardize? i attached a few sketches. connor: my vote: modal for destructive bulk actions. need explicit confirm + keyboard focus trap. :warning: neal: agree modal for bulk. for single-item delete inline is ok if reversible (undo toast). rachel: accessibility note: if modal, ensure SR announces heading then description. use aria-describedby and aria-modal. also ensure toast uses aria-live for undo. :accessibility: jess: copy nit: 'Delete 12 items' vs 'Permanently delete 12 routes'? be specific. for irreversible actions consider a confirm phrase. ada: good call. proposed copy: 'Permanently delete 12 routes? This action cannot be undone.' buttons: 'Cancel' / 'Permanently delete'. connor: prefer 'Delete 12 routes' as primary label — shorter. surface 'cannot be undone' in body copy below. neal: also show selection summary above the fold. on mobile the modal should be full-screen. rachel: screen reader flow idea: heading, description, collapsed list with 'show details' toggle. use role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and ensure ESC closes. jess: what about required markers and validation in bulk-edit forms? inline errors that push layout can be noisy — maybe inline tooltips instead? ada: actually two things: confirm patterns + validation patterns. propose: immediate inline errors for field-level validation; show error summary only on submit and focus first errored field. connor: agree. a11y addendum: when showing error summary, focus first error with element.focus() and set aria-invalid="true" on the field. neal: for mobile avoid sticky error banners that cover primary action. rachel: required marker nit: visual asterisk + expose aria-required="true". include hidden text '(required)' for screen readers. jess: recall we debated asterisk vs explicit 'Required' last sprint. leaning asterisk visually + sr-only '(required)'. ada: decision proposal: - destructive bulk -> modal with explicit count + optional confirm phrase when >100 items - single delete -> inline with undo toast - validation -> inline realtime errors; submit summary with focus to first error - required -> asterisk visually + sr-only '(required)' connor: :thumbsup: will update the spec and add component props: {role:'dialog', aria-modal:'true', confirmPhraseThreshold:100, undoToast:true} rachel: i'll add aria examples to docs. example snippet: ```html
...
``` neal: also add metrics: track undo click rate and accidental delete rate pre/post. jess: copy owners — i'll draft alternatives for primary labels for tone testing. ada: thanks all. i'll file a short RFC and attach prototypes. ping me if you want to pair on mobile edge cases.
